page.layout: One page of running text, with four marginal notes in the left margin (Sanguis., NB., Lingua., Caro.). Catchword "De" at the lower right.

main_text.p: caeterarum volucrum adipibus longè præ-fertur, vt pluribus in locis patet ex Galeno, præfertim 2. ad glauc. vbi de fcirrhis. At veró fanguinem profluentem à cerebro, fra-&to fcilicet capite, idem vel etiam anatum Sanguis.cum rofaceo co&tus fiftit, vel etiam vtriufque infufus fanguis. Sed peculiariter fanguis anatum contufis medetur oculis cum melle.

NB.Sanguinem anatum Ponticarum à Mi-thridate Rege nobilitatum inuenimus, spis-fatum enim mifcuit antidotis felici fuccellu, quoniam veneno viuerent, de nostris pol-liceri id non aufim, nifi experimento facto.
Contra lepores quoque marinos fanguis valet anserinus cum olei æqua portione: contra mala item medicamenta omnia fer-uatur cum Lemniaterra & spinæ albæ fucco in pastillos redactus.
Lingua.Anserum trium linguas inassatas, inque cibo sumtas hydrocelicis, id est, herniæ a-quosa afflictis prodesse, Anaxilaus autor est.
Caro.Porro in pefte aeris carnes anferinæ, in pefte verò aquæ anatinæ magis celebrantur: quæ verò pestis aeriæ aquæ que sint signa, vide cap. de aere.

page.notes: Printed letters "s" (long s) and "æ" are transcribed as plain s and æ per the convention. Marginal note "Sanguis." sits beside the line "cum rofaceo". Words "anferinæ" and "sumtas" are read from a slightly blurred scan and may need checking. The running head is set in spaced capitals and is copied as "DE VITA".
